{{Short description|Estonian chemist}}

'''Aare Laht''' (born 6 June 1948<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web |title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Aare Laht |url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/1246/aare-laht |website=www.president.ee |access-date=22 March 2021}}</ref>) is an [[Estonia]]n chemist.

He has worked at [[National Institute of Chemical Physics and Biophysics]]<ref name="Kiin, S. 1990. page. 219">Kiin, S.; Ruutsoo, R.; Tarand, A. 1990. ''40 kirja lugu''. Tallinn: Olion, page. 219.</ref>

In 1980, he was among the signatories of the [[Letter of 40 intellectuals]].<ref name="Kiin, S. 1990. page. 219"/>

In 2006, he was awarded with [[Order of the National Coat of Arms]], IV class.<ref name="president.ee"/>
